title: The Silent Conspiracy
subtitle: Round 3 — AI Chaos Room
summary: CEO Aarav Mehta was found dead in a locked server room. No signs of break-in. No CCTV footage. Just a shutdown... and a secret worth killing for. Your team must uncover the truth before the company — and the evidence — disappear.

suspects.name: Riya Patel
suspects.bio: Brilliant. Ambitious. Had full admin access to core systems and infrastructure.
suspects.alibi: Claims she was monitoring network load remotely from her office.
suspects.motive: Aarav discovered the Orion deal was a front for selling client data to a competitor and threatened to expose it.

suspects.name: Karan Malhotra
suspects.bio: Desperate to close the Orion deal. Huge sales commission on the line.
suspects.alibi: In a client meeting in Conference Room B.
suspects.motive: Stood to lose millions in commissions if Aarav blocked the deal.

suspects.name: Meera Iyer
suspects.bio: Knows the legal risks. Had heated disagreements with Aarav over corporate compliance.
suspects.alibi: Drafting contracts in her 5th floor office.
suspects.motive: Feared criminal liability if Aarav went public with data breach allegations.

suspects.name: Devansh Rao
suspects.bio: Maintains server clusters and access logs. Claims he was offsite during the incident.
suspects.alibi: Claims offsite maintenance duty at secondary datacenter.
suspects.motive: Paid off to execute remote log purges.

suspects.name: Vikrant Sethi
suspects.bio: Pressured executive team for early returns. Stood to benefit directly from the Orion deal.
suspects.motive: Needed immediate liquidity from the Orion data transaction.

evidence.title: Unsent Email Draft (Recovered)
evidence.content:
To: legal@datasphere.com
Subject: URGENT: Data Breach Concern

If anything happens to me, check Project Orion. I found inconsistencies in the access logs. Someone is selling our client data. I've locked the proof in an offline backup. Trust no one.
- Aarav

evidence.title: Internal Chat Snippet (Deleted)
evidence.content:
Riya (CTO): We need this deal to go through. Investors are breathing down our necks.
Karan (Head of Sales): Orion is our only way. Aarav won't approve it.
Riya (CTO): Then we make sure he can't.
Meera (Legal): Be careful. Too much risk.
Riya (CTO): I've handled worse. This stays between us.

evidence.title: Hidden Clue & Desk Drawer Note
evidence.content:
Sometimes the quietest systems hide the loudest secrets.
- Found in Aarav's desk drawer.
USB recovered from Aarav's pocket: Label ORION_BACKUP

evidence.title: A1Z26 Deciphered Cipher Note
evidence.content:
Aarav left behind a cipher:
Decode using A1Z26 (1=A, 2=B...):
15-18-9-15-14  2-1-3-11-21-16 -> O-R-I-O-N  B-A-C-K-U-P
Hint: It's a command, not a name.

questions.label: Question 2: Method of Murder
questions.question: What method was used to murder Aarav and attempt to cover tracks?
options: Poisoned coffee delivered 20m prior + admin power fluctuation & log wipe
Direct electric shock from high voltage server rack
Suffocation by automatic halon gas discharge
Blunt force trauma from server cabinet collapse

questions.label: Question 3: Primary Motive
questions.question: What was the killer's primary motive for silencing Aarav?
options: Aarav discovered Project Orion was selling client data to competitors and threatened exposure
Preventing an illegal stock short sale
